description: Kotlin Multiplatform framework layer — Gradle build, shared commonMain entry point, and expect/actual Platform surface for cross-platform targets.

buildHints.whenToUse: Pick kotlin-multiplatform when the user names KMP, Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose Multiplatform, expect/actual, or wants Jetpack Compose on iOS. For Flutter use flutter-app; for JS-driven mobile use expo-react-native-ts.
firstSteps: Install JDK 17+ and ensure `java -version` reports 17 or higher.
Install Gradle 8+ (`brew install gradle` on macOS).
Run `gradle dependencies --no-daemon` to resolve and download dependencies.
Run `gradle build --no-daemon` to compile commonMain and produce outputs.
Open `src/commonMain/kotlin/App.kt` — this is the shared entry point.
gotchas: Requires Gradle 8+ and JDK 17+ on PATH; invoke via `gradle <task> --no-daemon`.
iOS/Android native targets require the Kotlin Multiplatform Gradle plugin; this setup compiles the JVM/common target only.
Kotlin stdlib version must stay in sync with the kotlin("multiplatform") plugin version in build.gradle.kts.
Do NOT re-enable `kotlin.native.binary.memoryModel=strict` — the new memory model (default since Kotlin 1.9) is required by coroutines and Compose Multiplatform.
`expect` declarations must be matched by an `actual` in EVERY target source set — missing an actual in iosMain fails the iOS build only.
architectureNotes: `src/commonMain/kotlin/App.kt` exports `main()` — the minimal shared entry point. Extend commonMain with your cross-platform logic here.
Platform APIs go behind `expect fun platformName(): String` in commonMain with `actual` implementations in androidMain + iosMain (add those source sets as needed).
Auth/payments/sdk slot layers drop JSON config at the repo root; a bootstrap function in commonMain reads those and dispatches to the right platform service via expect/actual.

placeholders.description: rootProject.name `my-kmp-app` — replace with your project slug (the rootProject.name directive).
Package declaration — add `package com.example.starter` if needed; must match any platform actuals.
